name: chord_patient_v07_universal
description: Unified patient and clinic tool with universal location config. Use action 'lookup' to find patient by phone number, 'get' to retrieve patient by ID, 'create' to register a new patient, 'appointments' to get patient's scheduled appointments, 'clinic_info' to get clinic details INCLUDING insurance, routing rules, baby wellness config, and all location-specific data, 'edit_insurance' to change an existing patient's insurance provider, or 'confirm_appointment' to confirm a patient's appointment by appointmentId.
